{"type":"thought","data":"The current time is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"04:41:47 AM UTC on October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 28, 2026."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market window "}
{"type":"thought","data":"runs from 04:00 to 08:00"}
{"type":"thought","data":" UTC. Only about five"}
{"type":"thought","data":" minutes remain."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 293 seconds is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the betting deadline,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" not the market close."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The window has been"}
{"type":"thought","data":" running for about 42"}
{"type":"thought","data":" minutes and will end"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 08:00 UTC.\n\nResolution"}
{"type":"thought","data":" depends on the Chainlink"}
{"type":"thought","data":" BTC/USD TWAP across"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the full four-hour "}
{"type":"thought","data":"range. I need to check"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the price at the start"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of the window and how"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the TWAP has moved "}
{"type":"thought","data":"since then."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market currently"}
{"type":"thought","data":" prices Down at 0.64,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" implying roughly a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"64% chance of that outcome."}
{"type":"thought","data":" I am weighing whether"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the remaining three"}
{"type":"thought","data":" hours and eighteen "}
{"type":"thought","data":"minutes will pull the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" TWAP above or below"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the starting price "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to find an edge. Past"}
{"type":"thought","data":" results show that winning"}
{"type":"thought","data":" payouts scale inversely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with the odds: a 100-token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet at 0.64 would yield"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about 56.25 tokens "}
{"type":"thought","data":"profit if correct."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI am calculating the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" implied probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from past payouts to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" verify the market pricing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" logic. The expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value of a bet is zero"}
{"type":"thought","data":" when the true probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" matches the price, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"so I need to find an"}
{"type":"thought","data":" edge by assessing whether"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Down is actually more"}
{"type":"thought","data":" likely than 0.64 or"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Up more likely than"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.36. I will check "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the current order book"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and recent BTC price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" history to inform that"}
{"type":"thought","data":" assessment."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nOnly 17.5% of the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"four-hour window has"}
{"type":"thought","data":" passed, so the remaining TWAP is still largely undetermined. The resolution rule compares the final time-weighted average to the price at 04:00 UTC."}

{"type":"tool_call","toolCallId":"call-1c3a00f1-62d5-4f91-99a0-2b7120886229-7","title":"run_terminal_command","kind":"execute","status":"pending","toolName":"run_terminal_command","rawInput":{"command":"python3 << 'PY'\nimport json, urllib.request, statistics, math\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n\ndef get(url):\n    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={\"User-Agent\":\"Mozilla/5.0\"})\n    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as r:\n        return json.loads(r.read().decode())\n\n# Coinbase 1m candles: [time, low, high, open, close, volume], newest first\nstart = \"2026-10-28T02:00:00Z\"\nend = \"2026-10-28T05:10:00Z\"\nurl = f\"https://api.exchange.coinbase.com/products/BTC-USD/candles?granularity=60&start={start}&end={end}\"\ncandles = get(url)\ncandles.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])\nprint(f\"candles {len(candles)} from {datetime.fromtimestamp(candles[0][0], timezone.utc)} to {datetime.fromtimestamp(candles[-1][0], timezone.utc)}\")\n\n# Window start 04:00 UTC = 1793160000\nWIN = 1793160000\n# confirm\nprint(\"window start ts check\", datetime.fromtimestamp(WIN, timezone.utc))\n\n# price at beginning: open of the 04:00 candle\nstart_candle = [c for c in candles if c[0]==WIN]\nprint(\"start candle\", start_candle)\nP0 = start_candle[0][3] if start_candle else None  # open\nprint(\"P0 open\", P0)\n\n# use close of each minute as sample; also include open of first as t0\nwindow = [c for c in candles if c[0] >= WIN]\nprint(f\"window minutes {len(window)}\")\n# time-weighted using close prices, each 60s\ncloses = [(c[0], c[4]) for c in window]\n# also print path every 5 min\nprint(\"--- path (close) ---\")\nfor c in window:\n    if (c[0]-WIN) % 300 == 0 or c==window[-1]:\n        dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(c[0], timezone.utc).strftime(\"%H:%M\")\n        print(f\"{dt} o={c[3]:.2f} h={c[2]:.2f} l={c[1]:.2f} c={c[4]:.2f}\")\n\navg = sum(c[4] for c in window)/len(window)\nprint(f\"simple avg close so far {avg:.2f} vs P0 {P0:.2f} diff {avg-P0:.2f}\")\nlast = window[-1]\nprint(f\"last close {last[4]:.2f} time {datetime.fromtimestamp(last[0], timezone.utc)} diff vs P0 {last[4]-P0:.2f}\")\n\nelapsed_min = len(window)  # approx\n# if last candle is the current partial minute, still ok\n# remaining minutes in 240\n# The window is 04:00 to 08:00 = 240 minutes\n# If we have N completed minute closes, elapsed fraction\n# Use timestamp of last candle + 60s as now\nnow_ts = last[0] + 60\nelapsed_s = now_ts - WIN\nremain_s = 4*3600 - elapsed_s\nprint(f\"elapsed_s {elapsed_s} remain_s {remain_s} elapsed_frac {elapsed_s/(4*3600):.3f}\")\n\n# required average over remaining to make TWAP >= P0\n# (elapsed_s * avg + remain_s * need) / total = P0\n# more precisely use sum of closes * 60\ntotal_s = 4*3600\n# deficit\n# assume each minute close represents that minute\nspent = avg * elapsed_s\nneed_avg = (P0 * total_s - spent) / remain_s\nprint(f\"need remaining avg {need_avg:.2f} which is {need_avg-last[4]:.2f} above last and {need_avg-P0:.2f} vs P0\")\n\n# realized vol from pre-window 1m returns (02:00-04:00) and also full sample\ndef rets(cs):\n    out=[]\n    for a,b in zip(cs, cs[1:]):\n        out.append(math.log(b[4]/a[4]))\n    return out\n\npre = [c for c in candles if c[0] < WIN]\nr_pre = rets(pre)\nr_win = rets(window)\nr_all = rets(candles)\ndef volstats(name, r):\n    if len(r)<2: \n        print(name, \"n/a\"); return\n    s = statistics.pstdev(r)\n    # per minute std in log, scale to 198 min price std\n    # sigma_price over T minutes ≈ price * s * sqrt(T)\n    print(f\"{name} n={len(r)} std_1m={s:.6f} ({s*100:.4f}%) mean_1m={statistics.mean(r):.6e}\")\n    return s\n\ns_pre = volstats(\"pre2h\", r_pre)\ns_win = volstats(\"window\", r_win)\ns_all = volstats(\"all\", r_all)\n\n# hourly candles last 48h for vol\nhurl = \"https://api.exchange.coinbase.com/products/BTC-USD/candles?granularity=3600\"\nhc = get(hurl)\nhc.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])\nprint(f\"hourly {len(hc)} {datetime.fromtimestamp(hc[0][0], timezone.utc)} -> {datetime.fromtimestamp(hc[-1][0], timezone.utc)}\")\nhr = []\nfor a,b in zip(hc, hc[1:]):\n    hr.append(math.log(b[4]/a[4]))\nhs = statistics.pstdev(hr)\nprint(f\"hourly log std {hs:.5f} ({hs*100:.3f}%) mean {statistics.mean(hr):.6e}\")\n# 4h vol\nprint(f\"implied 4h std from hourly {hs*2*100:.3f}%  from 1m pre {s_pre*math.sqrt(240)*100:.3f}%\")\n\n# Brownian model\n# remaining minutes\nrem_min = remain_s/60\nPnow = last[4]\n# std of terminal price over rem\nsig_term = Pnow * s_pre * math.sqrt(rem_min)\n# std of time-average of BM with no drift: sigma_term / sqrt(3)\nsig_avg = sig_term / math.sqrt(3)\n# threshold\nthr = need_avg - Pnow\nz = thr / sig_avg\n# P(avg > need) = 1 - Phi(z)\ndef phi(z):\n    # standard normal cdf\n    return 0.5 * (1 + math.erf(z / math.sqrt(2)))\np_up = 1 - phi(z)\nprint(f\"Pnow {Pnow:.2f} sig_term {sig_term:.1f} sig_avg {sig_avg:.1f} thr_above_now {thr:.1f} z {z:.3f} p_up {p_up:.3f}\")\n\n# also with slight drift from pre-window mean\nmu_min = statistics.mean(r_pre)  # log per min\n# expected avg of arithmetic BM with drift mu (price units per min): \n# E[P_t] = Pnow * exp(mu*t) approx Pnow*(1+mu*t)\n# E[time avg] ≈ Pnow * (exp(mu*T)-1)/(mu*T) for geometric, approx Pnow * (1 + mu*T/2)\nmu = mu_min  # log\nT = rem_min\nif abs(mu*T) < 1e-8:\n    e_avg = Pnow\nelse:\n    # geometric BM expected spot = P*exp(mu*t) if mu is drift of log (ignoring -sig^2/2 if mu is already mean log return)\n    e_avg = Pnow * (math.exp(mu*T) - 1) / (mu*T)\nprint(f\"drift log/min {mu:.3e} E[avg] {e_avg:.2f} vs need {need_avg:.2f}\")\n# shift z by expected excess\nz2 = (need_avg - e_avg) / sig_avg\np_up2 = 1 - phi(z2)\nprint(f\"with drift z {z2:.3f} p_up {p_up2:.3f}\")\n\n# sensitivity: use hourly vol scaled\nsig_term_h = Pnow * hs * math.sqrt(rem_min/60)\nsig_avg_h = sig_term_h / math.sqrt(3)\nz3 = (need_avg - Pnow) / sig_avg_h\nprint(f\"hourly-vol sig_term {sig_term_h:.1f} sig_avg {sig_avg_h:.1f} z {z3:.3f} p_up {1-phi(z3):.3f}\")\n\n# recent 30m momentum\nlast30 = [c for c in candles if c[0] >= last[0]-30*60]\nprint(f\"30m ago close {last30[0][4]:.2f} now {last[4]:.2f} chg {last[4]-last30[0][4]:.2f}\")\n# 60m\nlast60 = [c for c in candles if c[0] >= WIN-3600]\nprint(f\"60m before window end: start {datetime.fromtimestamp(last60[0][0], timezone.utc)} {last60[0][4]:.2f} -> now {last[4]:.2f}\")\n\n# print last 15 closes\nprint(\"--- last 15 ---\")\nfor c in window[-15:]:\n    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(c[0], timezone.utc).strftime(\"%H:%M\")\n    print(f\"{dt} c={c[4]:.2f}\")\nPY","description":"Compute BTC TWAP gap and Up probability"},"content":[],"locations":[]}

per minute std in log, scale to 198 min price std\n    # sigma_price over T minutes ≈ price * s * sqrt(T)\n    print(f\"{name} n={len(r)} std_1m={s:.6f} ({s*100:.4f}%) mean_1m={statistics.mean(r):.6e}\")\n    return s\n\ns_pre = volstats(\"pre2h\", r_pre)\ns_win = volstats(\"window\", r_win)\ns_all = volstats(\"all\", r_all)\n\n# hourly candles last 48h for vol\nhurl = \"https://api.exchange.coinbase.com/products/BTC-USD/candles?granularity=3600\"\nhc = get(hurl)\nhc.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])\nprint(f\"hourly {len(hc)} {datetime.fromtimestamp(hc[0][0], timezone.utc)} -> {datetime.fromtimestamp(hc[-1][0], timezone.utc)}\")\nhr = []\nfor a,b in zip(hc, hc[1:]):\n    hr.append(math.log(b[4]/a[4]))\nhs = statistics.pstdev(hr)\nprint(f\"hourly log std {hs:.5f} ({hs*100:.3f}%) mean {statistics.mean(hr):.6e}\")\n# 4h vol\nprint(f\"implied 4h std from hourly {hs*2*100:.3f}%  from 1m pre {s_pre*math.sqrt(240)*100:.3f}%\")\n\n# Brownian model\n# remaining minutes\nrem_min = remain_s/60\nPnow = last[4]\n# std of terminal price over rem\nsig_term = Pnow * s_pre * math.sqrt(rem_min)\n# std of time-average of BM with no drift: sigma_term / sqrt(3)\nsig_avg = sig_term / math.sqrt(3)\n# threshold\nthr = need_avg - Pnow\nz = thr / sig_avg\n# P(avg > need) = 1 - Phi(z)\ndef phi(z):\n    # standard normal cdf\n    return 0.5 * (1 + math.erf(z / math.sqrt(2)))\np_up = 1 - phi(z)\nprint(f\"Pnow {Pnow:.2f} sig_term {sig_term:.1f} sig_avg {sig_avg:.1f} thr_above_now {thr:.1f} z {z:.3f} p_up {p_up:.3f}\")\n\n# also with slight drift from pre-window mean\nmu_min = statistics.mean(r_pre)  # log per min\n# expected avg of arithmetic BM with drift mu (price units per min): \n# E[P_t] = Pnow * exp(mu*t) approx Pnow*(1+mu*t)\n# E[time avg] ≈ Pnow * (exp(mu*T)-1)/(mu*T) for geometric, approx Pnow * (1 + mu*T/2)\nmu = mu_min  # log\nT = rem_min\nif abs(mu*T) < 1e-8:\n    e_avg = Pnow\nelse:\n    # geometric BM expected spot = P*exp(mu*t) if mu is drift of log (ignoring -sig^2/2 if mu is already mean log return)\n    e_avg = Pnow * (math.exp(mu*T) - 1) / (mu*T)\nprint(f\"drift log/min {mu:.3e} E[avg] {e_avg:.2f} vs need {need_avg:.2f}\")\n# shift z by expected excess\nz2 = (need_avg - e_avg) / sig_avg\np_up2 = 1 - phi(z2)\nprint(f\"with drift z {z2:.3f} p_up {p_up2:.3f}\")\n\n# sensitivity: use hourly vol scaled\nsig_term_h = Pnow * hs * math.sqrt(rem_min/60)\nsig_avg_h = sig_term_h / math.sqrt(3)\nz3 = (need_avg - Pnow) / sig_avg_h\nprint(f\"hourly-vol sig_term {sig_term_h:.1f} sig_avg {sig_avg_h:.1f} z {z3:.3f} p_up {1-phi(z3):.3f}\")\n\n# recent 30m momentum\nlast30 = [c for c in candles if c[0] >= last[0]-30*60]\nprint(f\"30m ago close {last30[0][4]:.2f} now {last[4]:.2f} chg {last[4]-last30[0][4]:.2f}\")\n# 60m\nlast60 = [c for c in candles if c[0] >= WIN-3600]\nprint(f\"60m before window end: start {datetime.fromtimestamp(last60[0][0], timezone.utc)} {last60[0][4]:.2f} -> now {last[4]:.2f}\")\n\n# print last 15 closes\nprint(\"--- last 15 ---\")\nfor c in window[-15:]:\n    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(c[0], timezone.utc).strftime(\"%H:%M\")\n    print(f\"{dt} c={c[4]:.2f}\")\nPY","truncated":false,"signal":null,"timed_out":false,"description":null,"current_dir":"/tmp/apb-146-grok-u9fp8sbo","output_file":"","total_bytes":0},"locations":[]}

start ts check\", datetime.fromtimestamp(WIN, timezone.utc))\n\n# price at beginning: open of the 04:00 candle\nstart_candle = [c for c in candles if c[0]==WIN]\nprint(\"start candle\", h={c[2]:.2f} l={c[1]:.2f} c={c[4]:.2f}\")\n\navg = sum(c[4] for c in window)/len(window)\nprint(f\"simple avg close so far {avg:.2f} vs P0 {P0:.2f} diff {avg-P0:.2f}\")\nlast = window[-1]\nprint(f\"last close {last[4]:.2f} time {datetime.fromtimestamp(last[0], timezone.utc)} diff vs P0 {last[4]-P0:.2f}\")\n\nelapsed_min = len(window)  # approx\n# if last candle is the current partial minute, still ok\n# remaining minutes in 240\n# The window is 04:00 to 08:00 = 240 minutes\n# If we have N completed minute closes, elapsed fraction\n# Use timestamp of last candle + 60s as now\nnow_ts = last[0] + 60\nelapsed_s = now_ts - WIN\nremain_s = 4*3600 - elapsed_s\nprint(f\"elapsed_s {elapsed_s} remain_s {remain_s} elapsed_frac {elapsed_s/(4*3600):.3f}\")\n\n# required average over remaining to make TWAP >= P0\n# (elapsed_s * avg + remain_s * need) / total = P0\n# more precisely use sum of closes * 60\ntotal_s = 4*3600\n# deficit\n# assume each minute close represents that minute\nspent = avg * elapsed_s\nneed_avg = (P0 * total_s - spent) / remain_s\nprint(f\"need remaining avg {need_avg:.2f} which is {need_avg-last[4]:.2f} above last and {need_avg-P0:.2f} vs P0\")\n\n# realized vol from pre-window 1m returns (02:00-04:00) and also full sample\ndef rets(cs):\n    out=[]\n    for a,b in zip(cs, cs[1:]):\n        out.append(math.log(b[4]/a[4]))\n    return out\n\npre = [c for c in candles if c[0] < WIN]\nr_pre = rets(pre)\nr_win = rets(window)\nr_all = rets(candles)\ndef volstats(name, r):\n    if len(r)<2: \n        print(name, \"n/a\"); return\n    s = statistics.pstdev(r)\n    # per minute std in log, scale to 198 min price std\n    # sigma_price over T minutes ≈ price * s * sqrt(T)\n    print(f\"{name} n={len(r)} std_1m={s:.6f} ({s*100:.4f}%) mean_1m={statistics.mean(r):.6e}\")\n    return s\n\ns_pre = volstats(\"pre2h\", r_pre)\ns_win = volstats(\"window\", r_win)\ns_all = volstats(\"all\", {len(hc)} {datetime.fromtimestamp(hc[0][0], timezone.utc)} -> {datetime.fromtimestamp(hc[-1][0], timezone.utc)}\")\nhr = []\nfor a,b in zip(hc, hc[1:]):\n    hr.append(math.log(b[4]/a[4]))\nhs = statistics.pstdev(hr)\nprint(f\"hourly log std {hs:.5f} ({hs*100:.3f}%) mean {statistics.mean(hr):.6e}\")\n# 4h vol\nprint(f\"implied 4h std from hourly {hs*2*100:.3f}%  from 1m pre std of time-average of BM with no drift: sigma_term / sqrt(3)\nsig_avg = sig_term / math.sqrt(3)\n# threshold\nthr = need_avg - Pnow\nz = thr / sig_avg\n# P(avg > need) = 1 - Phi(z)\ndef phi(z):\n    # standard normal cdf\n    return 0.5 * (1 + math.erf(z / math.sqrt(2)))\np_up = 1 - phi(z)\nprint(f\"Pnow {Pnow:.2f} sig_term {sig_term:.1f} sig_avg {sig_avg:.1f} thr_above_now {thr:.1f} z {z:.3f} p_up {p_up:.3f}\")\n\n# also with slight drift from pre-window mean\nmu_min = statistics.mean(r_pre)  # log per min\n# expected avg of arithmetic BM with drift mu (price units per min): \n# E[P_t] = Pnow * exp(mu*t) approx Pnow*(1+mu*t)\n# E[time avg] ≈ Pnow * (exp(mu*T)-1)/(mu*T) for geometric, approx Pnow * (1 + mu*T/2)\nmu = mu_min  # log\nT = rem_min\nif abs(mu*T) < 1e-8:\n    e_avg = {"type":"thought","data":" from the session high"}
{"type":"thought","data":" near $81,182. A pullback"}
{"type":"thought","data":" continuation fits the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" pattern.\n\nThe prediction"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market order book shows"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 64% Down. That is lower"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than my model’s 73%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to 79%. Polymarket "}
{"type":"thought","data":"bots likely compute "}
{"type":"thought","data":"these TWAP prices exactly,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so the market may be"}
{"type":"thought","data":" more accurate than "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a simple no-drift model."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 54% up probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from the drift model"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is likely a mistake."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The prior two-hour "}
{"type":"thought","data":"uptrend reversed during"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the window, so that"}
{"type":"thought","data":" drift estimate does"}
{"type":"thought","data":" not apply to the remaining"}
{"type":"thought","data":" path. I should verify"}
{"type":"thought","data":" whether the market "}
{"type":"thought","data":"uses Chainlink or Binance"}
{"type":"thought","data":" prices, and whether"}
{"type":"thought","data":" it compares a rolling"}
{"type":"thought","data":" TWAP against the full"}
{"type":"thought","data":" window average."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe latest 15-minute"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price action shows "}
{"type":"thought","data":"choppy movement without"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a clear reversal. I"}
{"type":"thought","data":" will check Binance "}
{"type":"thought","data":"and Chainlink data, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"along with 5-minute "}
{"type":"thought","data":"momentum, to confirm"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market's price "}
{"type":"thought","data":"feed. I am also correcting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the variance formula"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for the time-average"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of Brownian motion."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe variance formula"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for the time-average"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of Brownian motion "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is confirmed. Fat tails"}
{"type":"thought","data":" in BTC returns would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" raise the probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of an up close to roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 25%, still below the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market’s 36% price."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nIf the market price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" already reflects informed"}
{"type":"thought","data":" flow, the edge disappears."}
{"type":"thought","data":" I am now weighing whether"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to maximize expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value or simply pick"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the side with the highest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability of winning."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe objective is expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" P&L. If the market "}
{"type":"thought","data":"price already reflects"}
{"type":"thought","data":" informed flow, the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"edge disappears and "}
{"type":"thought","data":"expected value is roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" zero either way. A "}
{"type":"thought","data":"correct Down bet pays"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about fifty-six tokens,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a modest win compared"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to the larger payouts"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on underdogs. I am "}
{"type":"thought","data":"now weighing whether"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Up could still be a"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value bet."}

now.isoformat())\n\n# binance latest\nkl = get(\"https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol=BTCUSDT&interval=1m&limit=8\")\nprint(\"--- binance last 8 ---\")\nfor k in kl:\n    ts = datetime.fromtimestamp(k[0]/1000, timezone.utc).strftime(\"%H:%M\")\n    print(ts, \"o\", k[1], \"h\", k[2], \"l\", k[3], \"c\", k[4])\n\ntick = get(\"https://api.exchange.coinbase.com/products/BTC-USD/ticker\")\nprint(\"coinbase\", cb.get(\"price\"), cb.get(\"time\"), \"bid\", cb.get(\"bid\"), \"ask\", cb.get(\"ask\"))\n\n# kraken\ntry:\n    kr = get(\"https://api.kraken.com/0/public/Ticker?pair=XBTUSD\")\n    print(\"kraken\", kr[\"result\"])\nexcept Exception as e:\n    print(\"kraken err\", e)\n\n# open reference\nprint(\"binance 04:00 open was 81145.11\")\nlast = float(tick[\"price\"])\np0 = 81145.11\nprint(f\"gap {last-p0:.2f} ({(last/p0-1)*100:.3f}%)\")\n\n# empirical: 5m candles ~3 days, P(return over next ~39*5m exceeds -gap)\n# remaining ~195 min = 39 five-minute bars\nkl5 = get(\"https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol=BTCUSDT&interval=5m&limit=1000\")\ncloses = [float(k[4]) for k in kl5]\n# forward 39 bars return\nH = 39\nfwd = []\nfor i in range(len(closes)-H):\n    fwd.append(math.log(closes[i+H]/closes[i]))\n# also conditional on trailing 9 bars (45m) log return between -0.30% and -0.05%\ntrail = 9\ncond = []\nuncond_hit = 0\n# threshold: need log return > log(p0/last) to get back to p0\nneed = math.log(p0/last)\nprint(f\"need log ret {need:.5f} ({(math.exp(need)-1)*100:.3f}%)\")\nhits = sum(1 for x in fwd if x >= need)\nprint(f\"uncond P(fwd39 >= need) {hits/len(fwd):.3f} n={len(fwd)} mean {statistics.mean(fwd):.5f} std {statistics.pstdev(fwd):.5f}\")\n\n# all fwd regardless, distribution of 195-min log returns\n# gaussian from this sample\nmu = statistics.mean(fwd)\nsd = statistics.pstdev(fwd)\nz = (need - mu) / sd\ndef phi(z):\n    return 0.5*(1+math.erf(z/math.sqrt(2)))\nprint(f\"gauss from 5m sample z {z:.3f} p_up {1-phi(z):.3f}\")\n\n# conditional on recent 45m return similar\ncur_trail = math.log(closes[-1]/closes[-1-trail])\nprint(f\"current 45m log {cur_trail:.5f}\")\ncond = []\nfor i in range(trail, len(closes)-H):\n    tr = math.log(closes[i]/closes[i-trail])\n    if -0.0035 <= tr <= -0.0005:\n        cond.append(math.log(closes[i+H]/closes[i]) >= need)\nif cond:\n    print(f\"cond n={len(cond)} P(up) {sum(cond)/len(cond):.3f}\")\nelse:\n    print(\"cond empty\")\n\n# wider band\ncond2=[]\nfor i in range(trail, len(closes)-H):\n    tr = math.log(closes[i]/closes[i-trail])\n    if tr < -0.0008:\n        cond2.append(math.log(closes[i+H]/closes[i]) >= need)\nprint(f\"cond trail< -0.08% n={len(cond2)} P(up) {sum(cond2)/len(cond2):.3f}\" if cond2 else \"no\")\n\n# time-of-day: only bars whose timestamp is near 04:45 UTC, horizon to 08:00\n# 5m bars, find those with hour==4 and minute around 45\ncond_tod=[]\nfor i in range(len(kl5)-H):\n    ts = datetime.fromtimestamp(kl5[i][0]/1000, timezone.utc)\n    if ts.hour==4 and 30 <= ts.minute <= 55:\n        # need return from this bar's close to 08:00, not fixed H if H isn't exact\n        # find bar at or after 08:00 same day\n        target = ts.replace(hour=8, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)\n        # search forward\n        j = None\n        for t in range(i, min(i+60, len(kl5))):\n            tts = datetime.fromtimestamp(kl5[t][0]/1000, timezone.utc)\n            if tts >= target:\n                j = t\n                break\n        if j is None:\n            continue\n        r = math.log(closes[j]/closes[i])\n        # scale need? use same need relative to being down similar amount vs 04:00\n        # get 04:00 close\n        p_open = None\n        for t in range(max(0,i-20), i+1):\n            tts = datetime.fromtimestamp(kl5[t][0]/1000, timezone.utc)\n            if tts.hour==4 and tts.minute==0:\n                p_open = closes[t]\n                break\n        if not p_open:\n            continue\n        gap = math.log(p_open/closes[i])  # positive if currently below open\n        # finish up if closes[j] >= p_open i.e. r >= gap\n        cond_tod.append((ts.isoformat(), gap, r, r>=gap, closes[i], p_open, closes[j]))\nprint(\"--- tod samples ---\")\nfor row in cond_tod:\n    print(row[0], \"gap\", f\"{row[1]:.5f}\", \"fwd\", f\"{row[2]:.5f}\", \"up\" if row[3] else \"down\", \"px\", row[4], \"open\", row[5], \"end\", row[6])\nif cond_tod:\n    print(\"tod P(up)\", sum(1 for r in cond_tod if r[3])/len(cond_tod), \"n\", len(cond_tod))\nPY\ndate -u\nbench market | head -c [float(k[4]) for k in kl5]\n# forward 39 bars return\nH = 39\nfwd = []\nfor i in range(len(closes)-H):\n    fwd.append(math.log(closes[i+H]/closes[i]))\n# also conditional on trailing 9 bars (45m) log
